notes: Strong's own headline meaning for this entry is "to reside" (usage "dwell with"), not "honor" -- KJV renders this verse "now will my husband dwell with me". The person's gloss ("honor") reflects a different, widely-followed reading (BDB/HALOT connect this to an Akkadian cognate meaning "to exalt/honor", and ESV/NASB/NIV render "now my husband will honor me") rather than a citation mismatch on my part -- genuinely disputed between lexicons/translations, not settled either way by the single attestation. Shipped as "honor" per the person's gloss; flagging the dispute rather than treating either reading as certain.
